## About

This is the Fabric Python Notebook base image used.

The image contains:
- Mariner 2.0
- JDK 11
- miniconda
- python 3.10 kernel
- python 3.11 kernel
- pyscope kernel

## Featured Tags

- `latest`

```
docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/msfabric/pythonnotebook/applications/fabric-python-notebook
```

## Usage

```
docker run -it --rm -p 8000:8000 mcr.microsoft.com/msfabric/pythonnotebook/applications/fabric-python-notebook
```

Then, you can test the Jupyter Gateway by following URL:

```
### execute code
POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/sessions/test_session_id/statements HTTP/1.1

{
    "code": "1 + 1",
    "kernelName": "python3.10"
}

### get the result
GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/sessions/test_session_id/statements/0 HTTP/1.1
```
